quote: he'd end up snaking their customers
quote_cn: 最后他总是把他们的客户撬走。
example: The new hire spent a year poaching accounts from the old team.
example_cn: 那个新人一整年从老团队挖客户。
note: 动词 snake 本义蛇行，引申为暗中抢夺（客户/人才）。

quote: Last guy he ratted out was none other than his cousin
quote_cn: 他最后一个告发的人偏偏是他表哥。
example: He ratted out his own supplier to save himself.
example_cn: 他为了自保把供货商卖了。
note: rat＝卑劣小人／告密者。近义 squeal、inform on。

quote: It turns out he's missing, presumed dead.
quote_cn: 结果是他人间蒸发，被列为推定死亡。
example: The case has been closed as presumed dead since March.
example_cn: 案子自三月起按推定死亡结案了。
note: 法律/公文用语。presume＝推定。missing presumed dead 是固定搭配。

quote: Our chemist was blown away.
quote_cn: 我们那位化学家惊得说不出话。
example: She was blown away by the sample purity.
example_cn: 那份样本的纯度让她大吃一惊。
note: 被动式＝被震住。反义 blown off（被敷衍）。

meaning_cn: 超级实验室（大型隐秘实验室）
quote: it didn't come out of some superlab in Mexico
quote_cn: 这可不是从墨西哥哪个超级实验室出来的。
example: The trace suggested a domestic superlab, not an import.
example_cn: 痕迹指向本土的超级实验室，不是进口货。
note: super- 前缀表示规模极大。犯罪语境专用。

meaning_en: a place where drugs are manufactured
quote: Car was abandoned at what appears to be a cook site.
quote_cn: 车被丢在一个看起来是制毒窝点的地方。
example: Investigators found a cook site behind the warehouse.
example_cn: 调查人员在仓库后面发现了一个制毒窝点。
note: cook 作动词＝制毒。fixed 住所叫 stash house / safe house。

meaning_en: to be warned that you are being watched
quote: So be on notice.
quote_cn: 所以你们给我当心点。
example: Rivals were put on notice after the price war.
example_cn: 价格战之后对手们都收到了警告。
note: 警告语气。put someone on notice／serve notice。

word: burn the shit out of someone
meaning_en: to attack or outperform them fiercely
quote: you're burning the shit out of them
quote_cn: 你这是往死里揍他们。
example: Their team has been burning the hell out of the competition.
example_cn: 他们队把对手打得毫无还手之力。
note: 非常粗俗。也可说 beat the shit out of（揍）。

quote: Girls gotta be lining up left and right.
quote_cn: 姑娘们肯定排着队往这儿涌。
example: Offers were lining up left and right by Friday.
example_cn: 到周五各种邀约已经纷至沓来。
note: 字面「左右排开」。也作 coming out of the woodwork。

meaning_en: how a woman would view the situation
quote: That's a female perspective.
quote_cn: 这就是所谓的女性视角。
example: He asks a male client to check it with a female perspective.
example_cn: 他让男客户拿「女性视角」再掂量一下。
note: 职场谈体验/评审时常用。近义 consumer's eye。

meaning_en: to keep asking them for it
quote: I kept bugging her for a date.
quote_cn: 我一直在缠着她要约会。
example: He bugged accounting for the numbers for a week.
example_cn: 他缠着会计要数据要了一星期。
note: bug 作动词＝纠缠、烦。名词 a bug＝纠缠。

quote: It was before they tightened the stalking laws.
quote_cn: 那还是他们收紧跟踪骚扰法之前。
example: Regulators tightened the law on influencer disclosure.
example_cn: 监管机构收紧了网红广告披露的法规。
note: tighten up on sth＝加强。名词 tightening。

quote: I chased your Aunt Marie here all over creation.
quote_cn: 我当时满城追你玛丽姨妈。
example: He's been all over creation looking for the receipt.
example_cn: 他满世界找那张收据。
note: 老式口语＝everywhere。近义 all over the shop（满店都是）。

meaning_en: to decide firmly that you will get it
quote: Once you set your cap for something, or somebody
quote_cn: 一旦你盯上了什么东西或者什么人。
example: She set her cap on the managing director role.
example_cn: 她打定主意要拿下总经理的位子。
note: 19世纪戏服「向某人求婚」。语气执着，有时含轻蔑。

meaning_en: to be capable of achieving it
quote: I'll bet you didn't think your old man had it in him
quote_cn: 我敢说你没觉得你老子有这本事。
example: He's slow but he has it in him.
example_cn: 他慢，但他有那个能力。
note: 谈能力/毅力。相似 have what it takes。

quote: Confidence and and persistence.
quote_cn: 自信，加上坚持。
example: Persistence beat talent in the end.
example_cn: 最后是坚持打败了天赋。
note: 形容词 persistent；动词 persist in＝坚持做。反义 give up。注意原文引文里 and 重复了两次，是字幕转写重复，不是你的重点。

meaning_en: to realise what is really happening
quote: And once I caught on to that
quote_cn: 等我察觉到这一点之后……
example: It took him a month to catch on to the pricing change.
example_cn: 他花了一个月才察觉调价了。
note: get the hang of＝掌握窍门；catch on＝想明白。

quote: How do they think they can get away with this?
quote_cn: 他们以为这样就能蒙混过关？
example: He got away with it because nobody checked.
example_cn: 因为没人核查，他蒙混过去了。
note: 后接 it／sth。get away with murder 是习语（逍遥法外）。

quote: Certainly a second opinion, right?
quote_cn: 肯定要找个专家再看一次，对吧？
example: Always get a second opinion before surgery.
example_cn: 手术前一定要找第二个医生看看。
note: 医疗通用；也用于「再听听别人的意见」。

meaning_en: the branch of medicine dealing with cancer
quote: we find you the best the oncology dream team
quote_cn: 我们给你找最好的肿瘤科梦之队。
example: She moved into oncology after a fellowship.
example_cn: 她做完研究员的培训后转去做肿瘤了。
note: 形容词 oncological。发音「昂-科勒-吉」。

meaning_en: to be so obvious it need not be stated
meaning_cn: 不言而喻；不用说也知道
quote: I hope this goes without saying
quote_cn: 这件事我想不用我说了吧。
example: That he lied goes without saying.
example_cn: 他撒谎了，这一点不言而喻。
note: 正式。反义 it needs saying。

quote: These are mad tight.
quote_cn: 这些真是顶呱呱。
example: His new album is mad tight.
example_cn: 他的新专辑牛得不行。
note: 俚语（黑人英语），年轻人常用。反义 mad trash。

meaning_en: you are the one suffering from refusing
meaning_cn: 那是你不领情／是你的损失
quote: Your loss.
quote_cn: 那是你不识货。
example: They passed on the offer? Their loss.
example_cn: 他们没接那个offer？那是他们亏了。
note: 轻蔑或调侃。也可指真正的「损失」。

quote: It's been caving in left and right.
quote_cn: 房子到处都在塌。
example: The retaining wall started caving in after the rain.
example_cn: 雨后挡土墙开始往里塌。
note: 建筑/地质描述。反义 bulge out（鼓出去）。

meaning_en: to pay to release them from custody
quote: His cousin bailed him out.
quote_cn: 是他表哥交保释金把他弄出来的。
example: His parents had to bail him out twice.
example_cn: 他父母两次花钱把他保出来。
note: 名词 bail＝保释金。也可指财务上替人解围。

quote: He skipped town or something.
quote_cn: 他好像是跑路了什么的。
example: He skipped town the day the audit landed.
example_cn: 审计下来的当天他就跑了。
note: take to the hills 属同义俚语。名词 a skip town。

quote: I've been kinda doing my own thing these days
quote_cn: 我最近算是自己单干了。
example: After the split she just did her own thing.
example_cn: 拆伙以后她就自己干了。
note: 非常常用。近义 go it alone。

meaning_en: to want to use some drugs
quote: I could seriously go for a bowl.
quote_cn: 我是真想来一口。
example: After the week I had, I could really go for a bowl.
example_cn: 熬过这一周，我是真想来一口。
note: 俚语。bowl＝一管／一炉的量。反义 pass（在下一集用过了）。

quote: Take the edge off.
quote_cn: 缓一缓吧。
example: A walk took some of the edge off.
example_cn: 散了会儿步，火气消了些。
note: edge＝紧张感／锐度。take the edge off＝让…不那么紧绷。

meaning_en: to stop using or doing something
quote: I'll just lay off of it for a while.
quote_cn: 我先停一阵子。
example: He laid off the stimulants after the diagnosis.
example_cn: 确诊之后他把兴奋剂停了。
note: 职场义＝裁员。药瘾语境＝戒断，此处是前者混淆但都常见。

meaning_en: to tell someone to go away
quote: just tell us to piss off
quote_cn: 你就直说让我们滚蛋不就完了。
example: If you don't want to share, just piss off.
example_cn: 你要是不想分享，那就别来烦我们。
note: 粗俗。名词 piss-off＝让人恼火的人。

meaning_cn: 狗血剧情；家长里短的闹剧
quote: We don't need no soap opera.
quote_cn: 我们不要搞这套狗血剧情。
example: The board didn't sign up for a soap opera.
example_cn: 董事会可不想要一场狗血大戏。
note: 引申义与字面（肥皂剧）差距很大，职场指情绪化的纠缠。

meaning_en: to squeeze them into a busy schedule
quote: Thank you so much for working us in.
quote_cn: 太感谢您挤时间安排我们了。
example: Can you work us in on Thursday?
example_cn: 周四能给我们挤个时间吗？
note: 常指医院/美发/服务行业把客人插进空档。反义 squeeze in。

meaning_en: to help them when it mattered
meaning_cn: 帮了大忙；关键时刻顶上
quote: Marie really came through for us.
quote_cn: 玛丽真是帮了我们大忙。
example: She came through for the team on the last deal.
example_cn: 最后一单她替团队顶了下来。
note: 近义 pull through（挺过去）；come through＝最终成功。

quote: From here on out, things are gonna
quote_cn: 从今往后，事情会……
example: From here on out we brief in writing.
example_cn: 从现在起我们都用书面同步。
note: ≈ from now on。正式度高于 going forward。
